title: Inventory: distinct empty state for cold-start vs. filtered-to-nothing
goal: Audit finding: app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx (~L184-190) shows 'No items match these filters' + 'Clear filters' for a brand-new household with zero items ever tracked (A13's cold-start case) -- the same copy used for a real filter dead-end, which is actively wrong when there's nothing to clear.
in_scope: app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx: branch the empty state on whether the household has zero items ever tracked vs. zero items matching the current filters -- distinct copy and, for the cold-start case, a next-action pointing at capture (Add) rather than 'Clear filters'.
out_of_scope: Any visual/token restyling of the empty state beyond the copy/branching logic -- REQ-29/E-23 scope.
acceptance: A brand-new household (A13, zero items ever tracked) sees copy distinct from the filtered-to-nothing case, with no 'Clear filters' action when there are no active filters.
